tool_calls.input: const d=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat study/downstream/slots/r52541345d57e1747/docket.txt"});const table=[[0,0],[0,0]];for(const line of d.output.split("\n")){if(!/^[01],/.test(line))continue;const [g,r,e]=line.split(",").map(Number);table[g][Number(r===1&&e>0)]++};const [[hf,hs],[af,as]]=table,H=hf+hs,A=af+as,S=hs+as; function c(n,k){if(k<0||k>n)return 0n;let p=1n;for(let i=1;i<=k;i++)p=p*BigInt(n-i+1)/BigInt(i);return p}const w=x=>c(H,x)*c(A,S-x);const ks=Array.from({length:S+1},(_,i)=>i).filter(i=>w(i)>0n&&w(i)<=w(hs));const num=ks.reduce((s,i)=>s+w(i),0n),den=c(H+A,S);text({table,ks,p:Number(num)/Number(den),num:String(num),den:String(den),diff:hs/H-as/A})
